description: Change a cable by tag or id: retag, spec, gauge, length, outer diameter (od_mm), either end (the pin map resets to 1:1), replace the whole pin map (conductors), reset it (reset_pin_map), set the draw mode, or build it into a harness. Omitted fields stay the same.

bundle.description: Deprecated: the old name of harness.

color.description: Conductor color, IEC code or name (BN, WH, BU, BK, GN/YE…)

from_pin.description: Pin name on the From connector, e.g. "1"

gauge.description: Conductor gauge; default the cable's gauge, then the signal type's. Wire gauge: AWG ("18", "14 AWG", "1/0") or mm² ("1.5 mm²"). A bare number follows the project's gauge units. Default: the signal type's gauge.

signal.description: Signal type name or id. Default: the From pin's Codex signal.

to_pin.description: Pin name on the To connector

gauge.description: Default gauge for its conductors; "" clears it. Wire gauge: AWG ("18", "14 AWG", "1/0") or mm² ("1.5 mm²"). A bare number follows the project's gauge units. Default: the signal type's gauge.

harness.description: Harness tag (H1) or name to build it into (text that names no harness makes one); "" takes it out.

length.description: Cable length in the project's length unit; its conductors inherit it. null clears it.

od_mm.description: Outer diameter in mm, checked against the gland it passes (assign_gland). null clears it.

name: update_cable
title: Update cable
